items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I had always wanted to play with Maynard’s band... I did that with him. We were still playing quite a bit of jazz... So I went with that band for a year.

ctx.x: Right. Was that at the Top of the Plaza or something like that? In Rochester?
No, that’s where I played — the Top of the Plaza was across the street, that touring thing with Maynard Ferguson.
